body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q1FY25 call (2024-08-09), prompted: "a lot of these projects are scheduled to start from January 2026" Metric: Mexico service/warehouse operations start. Target: Start of supplies from Mexico. Deadline: 2026-01-31 (quarter). Specificity: precise. Status as of 2026-11-19: MOVED-GOALPOST. Evidence: First Mexico customer dispatch happened in Nov-2026, ~10 months after the Jan-2026 start; each new date was called 'on track'. Timeline: Aug-24 'projects start Jan-2026' -> Nov-24 'USD 6.5m from Q4FY26' -> May-25 'Jan-26 start, absolutely on track' -> Aug-25 'warehouse operational Oct-25' -> Nov-25 'operationally ready Oct-25, in line with planned schedule' -> Feb-26 (asked by an analyst) 'waiting for customers to start placing orders ... hopefully next quarter' -> Aug-26 'on track ... first deliveries expected in Q3' -> Nov-26 'first customer dispatch this month', 'single-digit million dollar revenue this year', 1 of 3 customers live. Management explanation: Customer IMMEX registration delay; customers ramping their own Mexico lines.
